report.title: PARC Bangna — Fresh Locale Screen
report.subtitle: Competition-aware Board Brief
report.canonical_rank_status: Fresh baseline preserved; competition is an evidence-bounded diagnostic and study-sequencing layer.
report.decision: Approve detailed study of the exact Top 10 shortlist. Do not approve investment, parcel acquisition, or a fabricated competition rerank of all 745 locales.

decision_scope.next_stage: Route-based catchments, competitor census, unmet-job validation, market-overlap consolidation, candidate-parcel access, and preliminary economics.
prohibitions: Not an approval to acquire land
Not an approval to deep-study all 745 locales equally
Not a final Top 10 investment rank

method.fresh_baseline_formula: 55% resident base + 25% routine breadth + 20% out-of-home evidence

pressure_rule.very_high: At least one high-impact competitor within approximately 1 km context or at least three high/medium-high venues within approximately 3 km after preliminary cluster deduplication.
pressure_rule.high: At least one high-impact venue within approximately 3 km context or strong regional supply whose effect still depends on the route network.
pressure_rule.medium_high_route_sensitive: Plausible supply exists, but river, road, crossing, or fragmented-street-retail evidence prevents a direct-pressure conclusion from straight-line context.

method.distance_use: Haversine distance is shown for orientation only. It is not a catchment, route time, or competition score.
method.unknown_rule: Unknown is never zero. Missing NLA, tenant count, or operating evidence remains explicitly unknown.
method.cluster_rule: Related venues may render as separate markers but are deduplicated through parent_cluster_id for future pressure aggregation.

source_context.venue_registry_limit: Lifecycle remains unverified at registry level; operating status is separately confirmed from cited sources.
source_context.coordinate_disclosure: Competitor coordinates are registry presentation coordinates. Candidate coordinates are reference points derived from the Fresh SVG scale. Neither creates a parcel or locale polygon.

caveats.text: Competitor coverage is decision-useful for the Top 10 but is not yet a frozen, equally complete census across all 745 locales; no numeric competition rerank is published.
No approved khwaeng or locale GeoJSON/WKT was supplied; candidate maps use reference points and a disclosed kilometre-grid fallback, not invented boundaries or catchments.
Fresh scores preserve the published baseline and do not include parcel access, complete competition, CAPEX, rents or investment economics.
